ruleDefinitions.name: Restricted Software Access By SRP
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects restricted access to applications by the Software Restriction Policies (SRP) policy Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name

sequences.query: (Provider_Name = "Microsoft\-Windows\-SoftwareRestrictionPolicies" AND (event_id = 865 OR event_id = 866 OR event_id = 867 OR event_id = 868 OR event_id = 882))
